title: Grateful Dead Live at Central Park on 1969-06-22
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > Cool Edit 2000 (pitch correction and filter) > CD (only the first 22 minutes of the show)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy debut of "Casey Jones" that gets the crowd dancing, yet the recording is a poor, incomplete audience capture.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the historic first performance of Casey Jones and the infectious dancing vibe, calling it a truly wonderful show. Unfortunately, multiple reviewers note that the audio is hopelessly bad – an incomplete audience (AUD) tape that detracts heavily from the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: The show itself receives strong praise for energy and a standout Casey Jones, but the recording is repeatedly described as bad or hopeless, pulling the overall rating down to a moderate level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers call the tape "bad and incomplete" and "hopeless," indicating low fidelity, missing sections, and generally unusable audio quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is highlighted for its dancing atmosphere and the excitement of a first‑time performance, though no detailed set structure is given.
